decision: Only fields with simple, independent, common scalar semantics are enabled for batch editing.
evidenceInspected: frontend-react/src/components/InventoryPanel.jsx current Inventory controls and save callbacks
frontend-react/src/utils/rfProfile.js profile resolution, payload serialization, and validation
frontend-react/src/App.jsx Inventory mutation and invalidatePlanResults behavior

notCurrentlyExposedByInventoryEditor.reason: Resolved and sent as part of rf_profile, but this Inventory editor currently provides no control for it.
Derived during profile resolution from whether an explicit receiver-noise bandwidth override exists; the editor has no control for source metadata.
Generated profile compatibility metadata; not user-editable.

sharedProfileRequestSemantics.singleCellEditMaterialization: The single-Cell editor resolves the full profile and writes that resolved profile plus the changed value into rfProfile. This preserves the editor's current behavior but can materialize defaults that were previously inherited. Batch editing stores only the enabled safe override fields.
sharedProfileRequestSemantics.serialization: Every context-dependent and safe-common RF profile field below is resolved for its Cell and serialized by rfProfileToPayload as a member of rf_profile. Single-cell simulation and path-profile requests include that profile; Network optimization, building-entry, and interference requests include a profile for each included Cell where applicable.
sharedProfileRequestSemantics.freshness: An Inventory profile edit calls invalidatePlanResults: in-flight RF work is cancelled, displayed RF results and dependent artifacts are cleared, and the plan is marked dirty. No RF request is sent by the edit. A later request serializes the edited resolved profile. Explicit Scenario save/version behavior remains the existing user-controlled flow.
sharedProfileRequestSemantics.fingerprints: There is no Inventory-specific or per-field fingerprint rewrite. The existing Interference UI request_fingerprint is JSON.stringify(requestPayload), so a changed serialized input changes it. Backend NetworkScenarioFingerprint and InterferenceScenarioFingerprint hash the normalized request, including RF profile inputs and per-Cell IDs/geometry for those endpoints. Other endpoints use their existing result/revision fingerprint behavior. An Inventory edit does not itself create a run or save a new revision.

fieldAudit.label: Longitude
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Cell marker position on the WGS84 map; also determines spatial/building context.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Stored in tower.coordinates[0]; dataset, project-local override, imported, duplicated, and manually placed Cells can have different provenance. No shared RF default.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Paired with latitude; both values identify the physical point used by map-area membership and later RF geometry.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Serialized as tower_lon or transmitter.lon for single-Cell requests and as tower_lon for Network Cells.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Moving the Cell invalidates current results and changes later geometry-bearing request payloads; saved input fingerprints follow the normal resolved Scenario flow.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Position is an individual geographic fact and may require a spatial or building-context review.

fieldAudit.label: Latitude
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Cell marker position on the WGS84 map; also determines spatial/building context.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Stored in tower.coordinates[1]; dataset, project-local override, imported, duplicated, and manually placed Cells can have different provenance. No shared RF default.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Paired with longitude; both values identify the physical point used by map-area membership and later RF geometry.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Serialized as tower_lat or transmitter.lat for single-Cell requests and as tower_lat for Network Cells.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Moving the Cell invalidates current results and changes later geometry-bearing request payloads; saved input fingerprints follow the normal resolved Scenario flow.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Position is an individual geographic fact and may require a spatial or building-context review.

fieldAudit.label: Technology
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: The per-Cell 4G, 5G, or 6G radio technology.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit rfProfile.networkTech, otherwise inferred from global frequency.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Changing Technology applies that technology's default frequency, band, bandwidth, and duplex as one UI action; PCI validation range also depends on it.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Serialized as rf_profile.network_tech, together with all resolved profile values.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: A technology change changes multiple carrier defaults and can make each Cell's frequency, band, channel, duplex, and PCI interpretation inconsistent.

fieldAudit.label: Frequency
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Per-Cell carrier frequency used for RF propagation and technology compatibility.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise the selected technology default when technology is explicit, or the global frequency when it is not.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Must map to the selected networkTech under networkTechnologyForFrequency; can affect the default propagation model when that model is not overridden and affects receiver/carrier interpretation.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: The same numeric value may be invalid for a selected Cell's technology and may cross technology/model boundaries.

fieldAudit.label: Bandwidth
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Per-Cell occupied/channel bandwidth used by radio and interference calculations.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise technology default for an explicit technology, or global interference bandwidth with technology default fallback.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Provides the default receiverNoiseBandwidthHz as bandwidthMHz × 1,000,000 unless an explicit receiver noise bandwidth is stored; range-validated.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Cells can resolve different technology/global defaults, and bandwidth can feed the derived receiver-noise bandwidth.

fieldAudit.label: Conducted TX power
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Conducted transmitter power before antenna gain and propagation losses.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise global simulation txPowerDbm.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Independent scalar; validated by the existing per-Cell RF profile range checks.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Serialized as rf_profile.tx_power_dbm; the single-cell request also retains the existing global top-level tx_power_dbm field.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Same physical quantity and unit for all selected Cells; existing validation runs against every resolved profile before any update is returned.

fieldAudit.label: Radius
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Per-Cell analysis/coverage radius limit.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise global simulation radiusMeters.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Independent scalar; profile range validation applies. Single-cell requests also preserve the existing global top-level radius_m field.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Serialized as rf_profile.radius_m; global single-cell radius remains in the top-level request as before.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Same length quantity and independent per-Cell scalar; the new value is validated for every selected Cell before atomic application.

fieldAudit.label: Beam width
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Per-Cell horizontal beam-width assumption.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise global simulation beamWidthDeg.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Independent scalar under the existing profile schema and range validation. Single-cell requests also preserve the existing global top-level beam_width field.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Serialized as rf_profile.beam_width; global single-cell beam width remains in the top-level request as before.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Same angular quantity for all selected Cells; existing profile validation is run for each Cell before the all-or-nothing update.

fieldAudit.label: TX boresight gain
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Absolute transmit antenna boresight gain; distinct from relative pattern attenuation.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Cell aliases txAntennaGainDbi, tx_antenna_gain_dbi, antennaGainDbi, and antenna_gain_dbi are accepted; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.antennaGainDbi.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Combined with per-Cell orientation, horizontal/vertical pattern, and downtilt when computing directional transmit gain.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Serialized as rf_profile.tx_antenna_gain_dbi and the legacy alias rf_profile.antenna_gain_dbi.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: The domain label denotes absolute boresight gain and may represent different antenna hardware/configurations across Cells.

fieldAudit.label: RX antenna gain
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Receive-side antenna gain applied to the link budget.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.rxAntennaGainDbi.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Per-Cell receiver hardware assumption; range-validated independently of TX gain.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Receiver hardware assumptions can differ per Cell and should be reviewed individually.

fieldAudit.label: System loss
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Explicit system/link loss term separate from propagation and calibration offset.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.systemLossDb.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Per-Cell loss assumption; validated within the profile's configured range.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Loss budgets are deployment-specific and may not be common across a selected working set.

fieldAudit.label: Polarization loss
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Polarization mismatch loss in the link budget.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.polarizationLossDb.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Depends on per-Cell transmit/receive polarization assumptions; profile range-validated.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: May encode different antenna polarization pairings among Cells.

fieldAudit.label: Antenna height
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Transmitter antenna height used by propagation and geometry calculations.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.antennaHeightM.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Per-site installation property; distinct from receiverHeightM and bounded by profile validation.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Physical installation height is site-specific and must be reviewed against each Cell's surroundings.

fieldAudit.label: Mechanical tilt
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Mechanical antenna downtilt from its mounting orientation.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.mechanicalDowntiltDeg.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Combines with electricalDowntiltDeg and the vertical antenna pattern; checked against downtilt limits.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Mechanical installation angle is a site-specific configuration and combines with other directional fields.

fieldAudit.label: Electrical tilt
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Electrical antenna downtilt applied to the vertical pattern.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.electricalDowntiltDeg.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Combines with mechanicalDowntiltDeg and the vertical antenna pattern; checked against downtilt limits.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Electrical tilt is part of the per-antenna directional configuration.

fieldAudit.label: Orientation
fieldAudit.units: degrees clockwise from north, normalized to [0, 360)
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Per-Cell antenna orientation used for directional transmit gain.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.orientationDeg; resolution normalizes degrees.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Combines with horizontal pattern, beam width, and tilt settings. Separate from Network optimization's per-Cell networkAzimuths state.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Serialized as rf_profile.orientation_deg; Network request geometry also carries the separate network azimuth where applicable.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above; networkAzimuths has its own existing result invalidation path.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Antenna pointing is spatially contextual and must not be confused with Network membership or optimized per-Cell azimuth.

fieldAudit.label: Horizontal pattern
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Relative horizontal antenna gain pattern model.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.horizontalPatternId.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Supported choices are ideal-sector, cosine-sector, omni, and 3gpp-single-element; directional interpretation also uses orientation and beam width.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Antenna pattern model represents hardware/model choice and is coupled to orientation and beam assumptions.

fieldAudit.label: Vertical pattern
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Relative vertical antenna gain pattern model.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.verticalPatternId.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Supported choices are flat, panel-10deg, and panel-20deg; interpretation combines with mechanical and electrical tilt.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Pattern is a model/hardware choice coupled to the antenna's tilt configuration.

fieldAudit.label: Band
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Human/system carrier band label associated with the Cell technology and frequency.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise the selected technology's default band.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Should remain coherent with technology, frequency, bandwidth, channel, and duplex; required text validation applies.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Carrier identity is technology- and deployment-dependent; the UI does not validate cross-field carrier consistency beyond individual profile checks.

fieldAudit.label: Channel
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Per-Cell channel label used in carrier/co-channel interpretation.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise generated as CH-{index modulo reuseFactor + 1}. Default IDs are intentionally reusable; this field is not a globally unique Cell identifier.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Backend co-channel handling uses channel/frequency/technology inputs; generated value also depends on Cell ordering and reuseFactor.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Channel reuse can be meaningful across Cells; changing many labels together can change co-channel grouping and interfere with per-Cell reuse plans.

fieldAudit.label: Duplex
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Per-Cell duplexing mode.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise the selected technology's default duplex mode.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Carrier/technology choice and deployment profile determine appropriate mode; value is enum-validated.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Mode is carrier- and deployment-dependent, not a generic numeric scalar.

fieldAudit.label: Cell load
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Per-Cell traffic-load fraction used by load-aware interference calculations.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise global cellLoadPct divided by 100, with 70% fallback.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Must be greater than 0 and at most 1; meaning is a utilization fraction, not a percentage value.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Traffic load is observed/planned per Cell and can differ across the working set.

fieldAudit.label: Reuse factor
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Per-Cell channel reuse plan parameter.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise global reuseFactor, then DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.reuseFactor.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Integer range is policy-limited; when channelId is not explicit, its CH-N default is derived from Cell index and this factor.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Serialized as rf_profile.reuse_factor; it may also change the resolved default rf_profile.channel_id.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above; implicit channel resolution can also change the later request payload.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: The field affects an implicit channel value and is part of a cross-Cell reuse plan.

fieldAudit.label: PCI
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Optional physical cell identity code.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Optional Cell override; absent value resolves to null.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Range validation is technology-specific: LTE 0–503; NR 0–1007. Current Inventory profile validation checks range but does not enforce deployment-wide PCI uniqueness.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: PCI is a deployment identity parameter with technology-specific range and potential collision-planning concerns; the current editor has no uniqueness analysis.

fieldAudit.label: Receiver height
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Receiver height used when evaluating the per-Cell link.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.receiverHeightM.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Distinct from site antenna height and may vary with analysis/building context; profile range-validated.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Receiver scenario assumptions can differ by user, device, and analysis site.

fieldAudit.label: Threshold mode
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Selects whether receiver sensitivity is entered directly or derived from noise inputs.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.receiverSensitivityMode.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Controls which inputs are active: manual validates receiverSensitivityDbm; derived validates noise bandwidth, noise figure, required SNR, and margin.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Serialized as rf_profile.receiver_sensitivity_mode and determines effective threshold interpretation.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Changing mode changes which other fields are operative and how the receiver threshold is derived.

fieldAudit.label: RX sensitivity
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Manual receiver threshold; retained in the profile even when derived mode is selected.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.receiverSensitivityDbm.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Range-validated and operative only in manual mode; derived mode computes effective threshold from bandwidth, noise figure, required SNR, and margin.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Serialized as rf_profile.receiver_sensitivity_dbm together with rf_profile.receiver_sensitivity_mode.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: A batch may include Cells using different threshold modes; overwriting this value could be inactive for some and active for others.

fieldAudit.label: Noise bandwidth
fieldAudit.units: Hz in profile; UI displays MHz
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Noise bandwidth input for derived receiver sensitivity.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit receiver noise bandwidth override; otherwise bandwidthMHz × 1,000,000.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Derived threshold mode only; changing carrier bandwidth changes this default unless an explicit noise bandwidth override exists. UI converts MHz input to Hz.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above; when implicit, a bandwidth change may also change this serialized value.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Unit conversion and the fallback dependency on channel bandwidth make an identical typed value potentially inappropriate across Cells.

fieldAudit.label: Noise figure
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Receiver noise figure input for the derived sensitivity calculation.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise global noiseFigureDb with DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE fallback.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Used only in derived threshold mode; range-validated there and combined with noise bandwidth, required SNR, and margin.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Receiver hardware and active threshold modes can differ across selected Cells.

fieldAudit.label: Required SNR
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Required signal-to-noise ratio for the derived receiver threshold.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.receiverRequiredSnrDb.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Used only in derived threshold mode; combines with noise bandwidth, noise figure, and margin.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Required quality target is receiver/service-specific and part of a coupled derivation.

fieldAudit.label: Receiver margin
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Additional margin in the derived receiver threshold.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Explicit Cell override; otherwise DEFAULT_RF_PROFILE.receiverMarginDb.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Used only in derived threshold mode; combined additively with noise, required SNR, and the −174 dBm/Hz thermal-noise term.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Uses the shared RF profile freshness and fingerprint semantics above.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Margin is a quality-policy assumption and part of a coupled threshold calculation.

fieldAudit.label: Internal Cell ID
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Application key used for selection, edits, map linkage, and local project operations.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Assigned by source/import/place/duplicate flows; uniqueness is enforced by those creation flows.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Referenced by Network selection, Inventory snapshots, undo/delete, and editor target state.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Used as the UI and inventory lookup key; Network request Cell IDs fall back to id only when cellId is absent. Single-cell RF requests use the selected Cell's coordinates and profile without a separate id member.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Identity changes would affect later resolved project/request inputs and break active UI references; there is no inline identity editor.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Stable application identity, not an RF assumption.

fieldAudit.label: Display/physical Cell ID
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: External or display Cell identifier shown to users and used as the RF request identifier when present.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Comes from dataset/import/place/duplicate creation; import resolves collisions. Falls back to id when absent.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Used by Network request payloads, search display/ranking, reports, and result-to-Cell mapping.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Network request builders send String(cellId ?? id) as the Cell ID.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Changing it would change request identity and project inputs, and can detach results or references.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Deployment identity must be changed through an explicit identity workflow with collision and reference handling.

fieldAudit.label: Inventory source
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Source lineage label such as dataset, project override, import, manual, or duplicate.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: Set by load/import/place/duplicate flows; editing a dataset Cell converts its source label to project override.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Used for source display and project-local edit semantics; it is not an RF profile value.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Not serialized to RF profile requests.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Not an RF request input; provenance may be retained in project inventory state.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Source lineage describes how a Cell entered the workspace and must not be rewritten as an RF edit.

fieldAudit.label: Network membership
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Ordered selection of up to six Cells for Network planning, separate from Inventory edit selection.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: App-owned selectedNetworkTowerIds; not inherited from the Inventory working set.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Determines which Cell profiles appear in Network request payloads and preserves user request order.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Changes membership/count/order of later Network requests.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Existing selection changes invalidate plan results; saved inputs follow normal project revision handling.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: Editing multiple profile fields must never silently add or remove Cells from the active Network.

fieldAudit.label: Network azimuth
fieldAudit.domainMeaning: Per-Cell Network planning azimuth state, separate from RF profile orientationDeg.
fieldAudit.resolutionAndDefaults: App-owned map keyed by Cell ID; falls back to global settings azimuthDeg.
fieldAudit.dependenciesAndDefaults: Used in Network optimization/building/interference requests and may be populated by optimization/recommendation workflows.
fieldAudit.requestImpact: Changes the azimuth member of later Network request Cell records; not rf_profile.orientation_deg.
fieldAudit.fingerprintImpact: Existing update paths invalidate Network/plan results; no Inventory profile fingerprint rewrite applies.
fieldAudit.batchDecisionReason: This is separate, optimization-sensitive planning state and is intentionally not an Inventory profile control.

batchWorkflow.selection: Local Inventory IDs from the active working set; minimum two; not Network membership.
batchWorkflow.mixedValues: Show Mixed across selected Cells and keep the replacement input blank; never choose the first Cell's value implicitly.
batchWorkflow.review: User enables fields, enters values, reviews an explicit preview, then applies.
batchWorkflow.validation: Existing RF profile validation runs for every selected Cell. Invalid/missing Cell or unsupported field aborts the whole batch before state mutation.
batchWorkflow.mutation: Apply supported patch to all selected towers atomically; mark dataset-sourced Cells as project overrides; refresh selectedTower object by identity if it was edited.
batchWorkflow.freshness: One invalidatePlanResults call after successful apply; no automatic RF task.
batchWorkflow.draftAndVersion: Uses existing App-owned tower/project draft flow; no new persistence schema or auto-save. Save Version remains explicit under existing Scenario behavior.
